about_the_game:
Step onto the pixelated pitch in Retro Rugby (demo), a fast-paced, action-packed 2D rugby experience with a modern twist! Featuring smart AI, physics-based collisions, and smooth controller support, this game delivers an authentic yet accessible rugby experience in a nostalgic top-down isometric style.

With smart off-the-ball running, your teammates anticipate plays, making every match feel dynamic and strategic. Whether you're pulling off precise passes, crunching into tackles, or making game-winning tries, every moment is driven by fluid physics and deep tactical gameplay.

Are you ready to lead your team to championship glory? Lace up your boots and get in the game!

Features:
🏉 Classic 2D action with a top-down isometric view
🎮 Full controller support for smooth gameplay
🤖 Smart AI that reacts dynamically on offense and defense

💥 Physics-based collisions for realistic tackles and gameplay flow
⚡ Intelligent off-the-ball movement – your team works with you

You get to choose from 4 different teams to play with in this DEMO. 

Match will only be 6min long. 

It’s time to relive rugby’s golden era—Retro Rugby is calling!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 9,10,11
  • Processor: Intel 8400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1030 OR RX550
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 250 MB available space

  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 10400
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 OR RX560
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
